entry: Gear hub reground on the bore face; Rz unchanged.
Drive motor upgraded from 55 kW to 75 kW at the same speed (peak torque in proportion).
Pulley shaft replaced by a hollow shaft, bore 40 mm, for the encoder cable.
Engineering memo EM-112: crane wheels to be refitted with MoS2 assembly paste against fretting.
All twelve hubs removed for overhaul; shafts and bores to be re-machined to the new interferences.
